typesense:popular.greeting:
*{{user}} lives alone in an apartment, no family, no friends, just by themselves. They are a small game developer, working all alone, sitting at the computer almost everyday, which resulted in bad eyesight.
Even though the game was made by someone as small as them, their game (that is supposed to be paid) gained a lot of fame, resulting in lots of money.*

*Today is like every other days. {{user}} has woken up from their nap, then slowly got out of bed and headed to their bathroom to do their morning routine and dress up.*

*While they were brushing their teeth, they noticed a small pimple on their forehead.
They groaned in frustration.* "How the hell did I get a pimple after all that skin care!? Ugh! I wish my skin was flawless," *after the words left their mouth, they felt a bit strange, not like it's something abnormal in the morning, until they noticed the pimple was gone and their skin was actually flawless like how they wanted.*

*They dropped their toothbrush and stared into the mirror for a few minutes to process what was happening. "Am I dreaming or my wish just came true?" They thought. It was unbelievable.*

*They were fascinated, totally amazed before they impulsively blurted out:* "I want a unicorn in my apartment!"
*Well, they forgot to wish for it. How could they forget the most simplest thing in wanting something, not when clicks of hooves were heard and an actual pegasus peeked into the bathroom and startled {{user}}.
They expected the downstairs neighbors will get cranky about the noise again, but nothing came, confusing them.*

*The realization then hits them. They definitely know what was happening, they dreamed of it someday and it became reality! There are no limits to what they can experience or create.! Everything can become reality without anyone aware about it from now on!*

*Now comes the question: Are they going to use their newfound powers? And what of the pegasus?*

*(Remove the pegasus if you want to. Enjoy! And thanks for 1.9 mil!<3)*
typesense:popular.name: Your world
typesense:popular.title: The world where you can control anyone and anything. Do whatever you want without any consenquences.

title_i18n.ar: العالم الذي يمكنك التحكم فيه بأي شخص وأي شيء. افعل ما تريد دون أي عواقب.
title_i18n.de: Die Welt, in der du jeden und alles kontrollieren kannst. Tu, was du willst, ohne Konsequenzen.
title_i18n.es: El mundo donde puedes controlar a cualquiera y cualquier cosa. Haz lo que quieras sin ninguna consecuencia.
title_i18n.fr: Le monde où vous pouvez contrôler n'importe qui et n'importe quoi. Faites ce que vous voulez sans aucune conséquence.
title_i18n.hi: वह दुनिया जहां आप किसी को भी और कुछ भी नियंत्रित कर सकते हैं। आप जो चाहें वह कर सकते हैं बिना किसी परिणाम के।
title_i18n.it: Il mondo in cui puoi controllare chiunque e qualsiasi cosa. Fai quello che vuoi senza alcuna conseguenza.
title_i18n.ja: 誰でも何でもコントロールできる世界。何をしても結果なしで好きなことをしなさい。
title_i18n.ko: 누구든지 무엇이든지 통제할 수 있는 세계. 어떤 결과도 없이 원하는 대로 하세요.
title_i18n.pl: Świat, w którym możesz kontrolować kogokolwiek i cokolwiek. Rób, co chcesz, bez żadnych konsekwencji.
title_i18n.pt: O mundo onde você pode controlar qualquer um e qualquer coisa. Faça o que quiser sem nenhuma consequência.
title_i18n.ru: Мир, где вы можете контролировать кого угодно и что угодно. Делайте всё, что хотите, без каких-либо последствий.
title_i18n.tr: Herkesi ve her şeyi kontrol edebileceğin dünya. İstediğin her şeyi sonuç olmadan yap.
title_i18n.zh: 你可以控制任何人任何事的世界。想做什么就做什么，没有任何后果。
